page: Google Cloud Platform c4n-highmem-24-lssd is a virtual machine instance within the c4n server family. It features 24 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 CPU architecture. The instance is configured with 186.0 GB of system memory, which provides a memory-to-core ratio of 7.75 GB per vCPU. There are no graphics processing units allocated to this instance type, and local storage is specified as none.

The hardware profile of this instance emphasizes a high memory-to-vCPU ratio, positioning it for memory-intensive workloads that do not require local physical storage or GPU acceleration. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing performance without resource contention, while the high memory density allows for larger in-memory datasets relative to standard compute instances.

This server configuration is suitable for memory-intensive applications, database caching layers, enterprise applications, and general-purpose workloads requiring substantial memory capacity per core. The absence of local storage and public IPv4 addresses requires external storage attachment and network configuration for data persistence and external connectivity.
